summary: Implemented the Databricks OAuth profile mapping. Added cosmos/profiles/databricks/oauth.py with DatabricksOauthProfileMapping (required fields host, schema, http_path, client_id, client_secret; secret fields client_id and client_secret; login/extra sources for client_id and password/extra for client_secret; profile adds auth_type oauth and env-var references for both secrets after profile args). Registered it in cosmos/profiles/databricks/__init__.py and cosmos/profiles/__init__.py (import, ordered list directly after the token mapping, __all__). Added tests/profiles/databricks/test_dbr_oauth.py covering claim checks, token-vs-OAuth selection, profile output, profile-arg override protection, and env-var outputs. Tests were not run and no repository code was executed, per instructions; verification is by reading only. Nothing was committed.
